answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a bonded stake with slashing. Each agent locks saffron tokens as collateral and proves its identity with a cipher signed by a unique hardware key, so one key cannot masquerade as many. Rewards scale with stake, not account count. If fraud is found the bond is slashed and the key joins a public spiral of banned identities, raising the cost of every later fake. To impersonate a thousand agents an attacker must buy and lock a thousand separate saffron bonds, while an honest agent risks only one.
